thread:
Nina (CSE): ACME iOS team reporting spikes of 429s right after a new build rolls out. also 401s on token refresh occasionally. only during the first ~10 minutes.
ACME Onboarding: our app calls init on cold start and again when opening a chat. token TTL is 5m, we rotate tokens frequently.
Jun (Support): smells like init stampede + short-lived ephemerals. do they debounce init calls client-side?
ACME Onboarding: no, each controller calls init independently.
Omar (Eng): two tracks: 1) ask them to upgrade SDK to the version that adds client-side singleflight/debounce; 2) temporarily apply a warmup bypass/quota bump during their rollout.
Nina (CSE): which SDK version?
Jun (Support): v0.9.3 includes initDebounceMs and reuses in-flight init results for a small window. Recommend initDebounceMs=3000 and extend token TTL to >=2m if possible.
Omar (Eng): I'll raise an infra ticket for a short quota bump and a warmup bypass for account 34721. SRE approval required.
deploy-bot: Created infra/issue-#2004  warmup-bypass request for acct 34721. Canary window proposed. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/warmup-bypass
Liz (CSM): I'll coordinate the 22:00 PST test with ACME and have them run a stepped ramp (10 -> 100 -> 1k) while we watch rate-limit headers.
Nina (CSE): sending ACME the 0.9.3 artifact and a config snippet:
```
// iOS
RedwoodSDK.configure({
  apiKey: "<ephemeral>",
  initDebounceMs: 3000,
  autoRetry: true
})
```
Jun (Support): ask them to capture x-rate-limit-limit/remaining/reset and any 401 bodies. we'll correlate with infra metrics.
ACME Onboarding: will test and post logs after ramp. thanks! :thumbsup:
